# brig

Manage agent-sandbox VMs running NVIDIA OpenShell on Fedora

## Synopsis

```text
brig COMMAND [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

brig manages the lifecycle of headless Fedora VMs that host an NVIDIA
OpenShell gateway, so autonomous agents run inside a VM boundary in addition
to OpenShell's own sandboxing.

Each VM's gateway is registered with the host's openshell CLI as brig-\<name\>.
A command that takes a VM NAME works on the VM that [`brig use`](brig-use.md) selected when you
leave NAME out, and says so on standard error.
Configuration lives in $XDG\_CONFIG\_HOME/brig/config.yaml. brig help topics
lists the concepts and how-tos that brig help TOPIC explains.

Exit status: 0 success, 3 not found, 4 exists already, 5 not ready (VM,
gateway or sandbox), 6 OpenShell config sync failed, 1 any other failure.

[Exit codes](../exit-codes.md) says what each status means.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--progress string` | how to show progress: auto, tty, counter, plain, none (env BRIG\_PROGRESS) (default `auto`) |
| `--progress-log string` | append a JSON event log of the work to this file, by default $XDG\_STATE\_HOME/brig/activity.jsonl; empty for none (env BRIG\_PROGRESS\_LOG) |
| `-v, --version` | version for brig |
